metricUnits.predictivePlusMinus: percentage points; lower/more negative predicts greater accuracy, incorporates transparency
metricUnits.meanRevertedBias: D-minus-R percentage points; positive indicates historically overestimating Democrats
metricUnits.simpleAverageError: absolute error in margin between top two candidates, percentage points
metricUnits.racesCalledCorrectly: fraction, not percent; publisher warns this is a poor accuracy measure compared with polling error

unratedPolicy: No matched sourced rating means grade=null and status=unrated. Never assign a fabricated letter grade or map unknown pollsters silently to a rated firm.
